question: Which of the following is a unit of acceleration?
solution:
The correct answer is **__m/s/s__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Acceleration**

 
• Any process in which the **velocity varies** is referred to as acceleration. Because **velocity is both a speed and a direction,** there are only two ways to accelerate: modify your speed or your direction—or both.
